buys.item: Lunch at a dhaba: dal, rice, roti

answer.thought: The spirit cannot subsist on the abstract idea of sustenance; the body, that stubborn particular, demands the universal medium of food. I have only ninety-six rupees, yet the system of needs does not negotiate with the poverty of the philosopher. I must purchase this meal, for even the dialectic requires a material substrate to operate upon.

errors: that costs ₹220 and you have only ₹96 in cash
